dataset_title: HybPriCare-QJM v1.0: An Integrated Geospatial Dataset for Hybrid Primary-Care Network Design and Digital Vulnerability Analysis

digital_vulnerability_index.definition: Equal-weight composite of nationally scaled area-level vulnerability components; not a population exclusion fraction.

percentile_rank_convention.connectivity_scaling: zero values fixed at 0; positive values scaled as rank_average / n_positive among positive-risk English LSOAs

pharmacy_site_rule: NHSBSA records with PHARMACY_TYPE=PHARMACY were retained for NHS Lincolnshire ICB after excluding private and distance-selling contractors; seven out-of-hours source records were retained and all eligible records were collapsed to one candidate site per geocoded coordinate pair.
public_identifier_policy: GP practice names, source contractor names, and source contractor codes are omitted from the public facility tables. Stable gp_id and author-created hub_id values support joins to the deposited distance matrices; source_record_count preserves candidate-location consolidation information.
